 20 Nov
 1
 min read
 Share on social
 Facebook Link

 Linkedin Link 
 Linkedin Link 
 Tasmania JackJumpers import David Johnson will return from a calf injury this Saturday to suit up against the Illawarra Hawks at MyState Bank Arena.
 Johnson averaged 16.2ppg across 9 games in the early part of the season before suffering the minor injury and now returns for the JackJumpers final home game before the FIBA break.
 “We’re pleased to welcome back DJ. He’s been diligent with his rehab and it’s great to be able to have him back for this last game before the break” General Manager Basketball, Darren Smith said.
